item.title: Smart glasses detector app warns if you're being recorded
item.summary: New Android app detects nearby smart glasses that could be secretly recording you. Nearby Glasses scans Bluetooth to alert users of potential cameras.

item.title: Brother of Michigan synagogue attacker was Hezbollah commander, Israel alleges
item.summary: Ibrahim Muhammad Ghazali, brother of the Michigan synagogue attacker, was a Hezbollah commander killed in an Israeli strike, Israeli intelligence revealed.

item.title: Rising gas prices from Iran conflict put GOP on defense after previous Biden attacks

item.title: Ben Shapiro praises Trump’s Iran strikes as ‘single bravest foreign policy move of my lifetime’
item.summary: Ben Shapiro calls Trump's Iran strategy "the single bravest foreign policy move" of his lifetime, praising bold reassertion of American authority on the world stage.

item.title: Pentagon identifies 6 US airmen killed in refueling tanker crash in Iraq after midair collision
item.summary: The War Department confirmed the identifies of the six U.S. airmen who were killed when a KC-135 refueling aircraft crashed in western Iraq during a mission.

item.title: Airline CEOs torch lawmakers for turning air travel into a ‘political football’

item.title: AI comes with a hefty charge. Are you the one who gets stuck with the bill?

item.summary: From reluctant concert-goer to devoted Deadhead, one fan's transformative journey following Jerry Garcia and the Grateful Dead reveals music as religion and community.
